dimensions.evidence: Observed Cvm3216, ORVM288, ORVStats40, ORVDerived16 and actual algo_pool144 bytes on Linux x86-64. Full32-bit generation is preserved outside the compact ORFrame identity index.
At most16 pairs,32strong fields and216 active value slots. Uninitialized locals and integer lookalikes do not enter the root graph; registered scalars still consume registration capacity.

VM/control/registered objects have explicit nested borrow lifetimes. Pool ticket high32 generations retire at maximum. Moved values receive destination generation plus one; retired destinations are skipped. No raw heap address survives collection.

Every usable copy is registered or belongs to an explicit VM root class. Staging precedes publication. Callback status failure preserves public output while already-completed VM effects remain; hidden argument roots are removed on every normal return.

No native heap allocation in adapter; actual cvm_pair admits typed pairs, actual algo_pool admits registrations. A collecting pair operation requires the exact argument objects registered and preflights a free cell before invoking the baseline allocator.

Stages full3216-byte VM, up to216 value addresses,16 derived values and finite graph/map data. Stable relocation updates all fields and every mapped copy. Current color-array marking gives O(H squared+R) worst-case time for variable capacities.

Collector reclaims unreachable logical pairs and preserves physical generation history. Registration release invalidates its ticket. Foreign callbacks cannot escape using longjmp or retain pointers to their local argument copies.

Actual compiler and CVM execute the three-frame program; collection then occurs at stopped boundaries or the new allocating foreign boundary. It is not an instruction-level poll insertion or arbitrary failed-instruction resumption engine. The compiler-managed statepoint experiment is separate.

All adapter access is externally serialized. paused is an asserted ownership boundary, not a thread-stopping mechanism. The family TSan profile covers actual other threaded adapters; it does not prove a concurrent CVM collector.

Four injected stages and budget0 verify unchanged VM/derived roots/metrics. Registration second-admission rollback, callback error after allocation, generation/counter exhaustion and stale-ticket refusal are independently asserted.

Actual GCC/Clang O0/O2/O3 source-bound builds include clean, unchanged and one-header rebuild. Executed O2 assembly calls actual or_mark_begin/step and or_safepoint; Clang emits hosted memcpy, GCC a stack-check helper. These are declared hosted dependencies.

GCC/Clang O2 whole-probe text36171/42315, data752/624, bss16/16 bytes. orv_collect compiler frame5792/5704; orv_call192/104; orv_pair112/120; baseline cvm_collect96/48. Nested frame sums and callers need separate whole-call-chain accounting.

Imported runtime/pool source is pinned. Fault/measurement imports are concrete extensions of their producer contracts, not nonexistent APIs. LLVM statepoint stack mutation is explicitly x86-64 ABI/compiler behavior, not ISO C automatic root tracking.

observation.scope: 720 retained samples plus48 first-sample warmups; four admitted object counts, two policies,1000full lifecycles per sample; identical logical surviving fields, different physical placements. Includes construction/admission/verification, not collection-only timing.
observation.limits: Single-host variation and source-specific sizes; no physical cache events, real-time bound, arbitrary heap scaling or independent learner claim.

sealed_decision.choice: Keep baseline nonmoving CVM unchanged; use an explicit stopped-state moving adapter with transactional staging when relocation is the studied requirement.
sealed_decision.reason: This makes generation and complete-root obligations executable while retaining a separate actual reference collector. Measured staging costs and a roughly5.7KiB collection frame preclude treating it as a free drop-in embedded replacement.
sealed_decision.reopen_when: A dispatch-integrated cooperative poll, concurrent collector, larger heap, smaller stack budget or production compiler stack-map subset is required.
